description: Correlation of price return to coverage change, lagged -1 to +3 days, over 30d or 90d: whether BCA coverage leads price. Unseeded until at least 8 paired days of price and coverage exist. Pro tier. meta.status is unseeded when there is no measurement yet (data.value is then a placeholder), partial when some inputs were defaulted (meta.diagnostic.missing) and stale when the newest value is over 48 hours old. An unknown entity is an error (HTTP 404).
name: get_editorial_premium
